name: Exception Handling and Recovery
description: Agent detects execution failures, classifies them by recoverability, and applies a tiered recovery strategy: retry with backoff, fall back to alternative tool, escalate to human, or abort with structured error. Keeps the agent robust under unreliable tools and APIs.
when_to_use: Tool calls or API integrations may fail transiently
Partial completion is preferable to full failure
benefits: Graceful degradation instead of hard failure
Clear escalation paths for non-recoverable errors
Improved user trust through transparent failure modes
drawbacks: Retry storms can amplify load on downstream
Recovery logic adds code surface and test burden
Risk of masking real bugs behind retries
Classification of transient vs permanent errors is heuristic
use_cases: LLM tool-use loops with rate-limit backoff
Distributed agent systems with circuit breakers

typescript.description: Tiered recovery wrapper around an operation.
